page.content:
Germany, Italy, Japan, and their dependent partners.

How Axis connects

  • Faction: Allies — The Allies fought the Axis to unconditional surrender.
  • Topic: World War II — The Axis is the aggressive alliance of the Second World War.
  • Faction: Nazi Germany — Nazi Germany was the European core of the Axis.
  • Faction: Imperial Japan — Imperial Japan was the Pacific core of the Axis.
  • Character: Benito Mussolini — Mussolini's Italy was the original Axis partner.

What is Axis?

The Axis, named from the Rome–Berlin axis and later the Tripartite Pact, was the aggressive alliance the Allies destroyed. Its racial and imperial programs drove both the European and Pacific wars.

Key threads lead to Allies, World War II, Nazi Germany, Imperial Japan and Benito Mussolini.
